players.product: High-capacitance (1uF-100uF) X5R/X6S BME MLCCs (GRM/GCM series) for PDN decoupling

quarterly_data.quarter: Murata press release: Murata Begins Mass Production of World's Smallest 0201-inch (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Murata has begun mass production of the LLD series three-terminal low-ESL MLCCs in 0201-inch size (0.6 x 0.3 mm), which it calls the world's smallest, reducing mounting area by approximately 64% versus its previous smallest 0402-inch size, for IC power-supply stabilization in smartphones and wearables. Two models: LLD033R60G105ME01 (1uF, 4 Vdc, -55 to +85C) and LLD033D80E105ME01 (1uF, 2.5 Vdc, -55 to +105C).
quarterly_data.figure: 0201-inch (0.6 x 0.3 mm); approximately 64% smaller mounting area; 1uF at 4 Vdc / 2.5 Vdc
